"""The ``app:greet`` console command."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import final

from xtr_console import ConsoleStyle, ExitCode, as_command, escape

__all__ = ["GreetCommand"]


@final
@as_command("app:greet", description="Describe what app:greet does.")
class GreetCommand:
    """Runs ``app:greet``; describe what it is for here."""

    async def __call__(self, io: ConsoleStyle, name: str, *, yell: bool = False) -> int:
        """Run ``app:greet``.

        Args:
            io: Where the command writes.
            name: Name.
            yell: Yell.

        """
        io.text(escape(f"{name=}"))
        io.text(escape(f"{yell=}"))
        io.success("app:greet ran.")
        return ExitCode.SUCCESS
